Replace the humanOnlyApproval boolean with a reviewFlow preset
(agent_approval | human_approval) so more flows can be added later
without migrating persisted data. The Approved column settings are now a
popover with a radio choice and an optional free-text instruction for
agents. The instruction is saved in the kanban state, readable through
kanban_get and appended to review requests sent to the reviewer. It never
changes who may approve; enforcement stays in the controller.

Add controller, IPC, kanban state and component tests plus a flow parity
check between the shared constants and the controller.

* fix(e2e): keep review-flow CDP fixture expressions static

* fix(e2e): open the review flow popover with a click

Radix Popover opens from click, not from the Enter keydown that the old
dropdown trigger used, so the CDP step never opened the panel. Scroll the
settings button into view (the Approved column sits off-screen in the grid)
and click it.

* fix: satisfy frozen source caps for review-flow changes

* feat(review-flow): default for all teams with per-team override

The review flow used to be a per-team setting that every team wrote with
an explicit value. It is now a default for all teams plus an optional
override per team:

- the default lives in <claudeDir>/review-flow-defaults.json; a team
  follows it unless its kanban-state.json carries its own reviewFlow
  (an override replaces the flow and the prompt as a unit)
- the controller stays the single enforcement point and fails closed on
  an unreadable default or invalid team fields; the default is never
  written into team files
- repair path: a team with invalid saved fields can be reset or
  overwritten, and an unreadable default can be replaced from the UI
- new feature slice src/features/review-flow (contracts, pure domain,
  application ports, main adapters, preload bridge, renderer) with
  layer boundaries enforced by eslint
- new "Review flow" settings tab: searchable team picker, "All teams"
  selected by default, per-team "use default" switch, list of teams
  with custom or unreadable settings; the Approved column popover reuses
  the same editor
- real Electron e2e covers the team override cycle and the default set
